crossRefs.note: A good man leaves an inheritance to his children’s children, but the wealth of the sinner is stored for the righteous.
He who increases his wealth by excessive interest gathers it for one who has pity on the poor.
For to the man who pleases him, God gives wisdom, knowledge, and joy; but to the sinner he gives travail, to gather and…

translations.web: he may prepare it, but the just will put it on, and the innocent will divide the silver.
translations.bsb: what he lays up, the righteous will wear, and his silver will be divided by the innocent.
translations.kjv: He may prepare it, but the just shall put it on, and the innocent shall divide the silver.
translations.asv: He may prepare it, but the just shall put it on, And the innocent shall divide the silver.
